svg.title: Two source reservoirs retain gaps and selection notes
svg.desc: Keep board and transcript reservoirs separate, each with gaps and selection tags. Sources are inputs awaiting interpretation, not already polished findings. Visual distinction: Two independent open collection trays, each with an incomplete ruled margin and blank center. Keeps board dump and transcript inputs separate; decorations are uncounted source notation.
